name: seed
stdout:
seeding (template the crystal on the_stone's handedness ⊥=𐑫):  {monad, the_stone, monad, the_stone}
  ── templated fraction (EVALT — matches the seed's handedness, copies the polymorph) ──
    the_stone, the_stone
  ── spontaneous fraction (EVALF — off-template, takes the default polymorph) ──
    monad, monad
  ~ B: racemic twinning — templated and spontaneous domains coexist in equal measure.
  FFUSE → total crystalline mass (seeding transforms the pool, not a pure conservative split).
